Instructions: 1. Find the column for the model of outdoor unit that is being installed. 2. Find the row for the model of the indoor unit that is being installed. 3. Find the cell in the table in which this row and column meet. In this cell the appropriate orifice / TXV and charge addition for this match are listed. If the text in this cell is BOLD, then a change of orifice is necessary. 4. If a change in restrictor is necessary, then the appropriate restrictor will already be supplied with the outdoor unit. Examples: • For the *SH4BE030KA / B6BMM030K-A match, the appropriate restrictor is the 0.062" and 8 ounces of refrigerant must be added (CHARGE ADDITION). • For the *SH4BE060KA / B6BMM060K-C match, the indoor restrictor will need to be changed to the 0.091", the outdoor restrictor must be changed to the 0.074", and 3 ounces of refrigerant must be added (CHANGE IN INDOOR RESTRICTOR, OUTDOOR RESTRICTOR, AND CHARGE ADDITION).
